name: dummyrun-site-checks
description: Checks for the dummyrun.dev website. Hugo builds the site; these tools check the output.

scripts.check:a11y: cd .. && go run ./cmd/dummyrun a11y --sitemap http://127.0.0.1:1313/sitemap.xml --rebase http://127.0.0.1:1313 --allow site/a11y-allow.txt http://127.0.0.1:1313/404.html
